note: Turn 6 — a phrase in her own voice. Usually the best line in a eulogy.

nextQuestion.text: Was there a hard stretch she came through? We can set that aside if you would rather.

chapterUpserts.title: Well, we’ll see
chapterUpserts.summary: Her answer to almost everything was "Well, we’ll see" — which the family understood to mean anything from yes to absolutely not.

anecdoteAdds.text: Her answer to almost everything was "Well, we’ll see." Thirty years in, the grandchildren could tell from the length of the pause whether it meant yes.

coverage.note: Enough voice and detail to draft from.
